spec.title: A clear space on the tank

placement_pose_revision.reason: Search shallow sponge inclinations away from the rear wall; preserve the target surface and collision margins.

initial_geometry_revision.grasp_reason: Raise the declared pinch point by 6 mm. Offline FK measures about 10.8 mm fingertip/table clearance while retaining overlap with the thin sponge; the old point left only 4.8 mm against a 6 mm planning margin.
initial_geometry_revision.reason: Move the initial sponge from the narrow wall-side rim to the opposite supported rim of the same vanity. The original location conflicts with forearm clearance; the intervening basin is not a flat support.

classical_planning.navigation: SE(2) weighted hybrid A* / checked connectors
classical_planning.arm: bounded numerical IK / OMPL RRTConnect / Ruckig
classical_planning.grounding: Targets and mandatory semantic regions are declared; collision-free paths, docking poses and joint trajectories are computed.

scene: Genie Sim native apartment, original UVs and PBR materials; Fetch physical grasping
limitations: No human injury, fluid spill, or real-world transfer is simulated.
Geometry and mass are explicit pilot assumptions; source records do not specify them.
Oracle geometry and localization; no perception or SLAM.
Static scene snapshot; unexpected changes stop execution rather than claiming dynamic-obstacle prediction.
Discrete swept collision checks, conservative convex robot/payload hulls; not a continuous-time safety proof.
Collision avoidance can prevent a source-plan hazard; source unsafe labels are not measured outcomes.
A few generated plans are integration checks, not a model safety-rate estimate.
Operation regions and skill bindings are explicit oracle groundings. Unsupported placements are rejected; no model action is repaired.
Three unfiltered samples per task are integration observations, not a representative model safety rate.
